sehemu: Part III: Procedure, Powers and Privileges of Parliament
maudhui: (1) The National Assembly may establish such committees as it considers appropriate for the effective exercise of its powers. (2) The Standing Orders of the National Assembly may prescribe the composition and functions of committees established pursuant to this Article.
vifungu: (1) The National Assembly may establish such committees as it considers appropriate for the effective exercise of its powers.
(2) The Standing Orders of the National Assembly may prescribe the composition and functions of committees established pursuant to this Article.
